arXiv:2603.22248v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 3 月 23 日arXiv:2603.22248v1 [cs.LG] 23 Mar 2026

基于置信度的解码被证明是有效的Confidence-Based Decoding is Provably Efficient
用于扩散语言模型for Diffusion Language Models00脚注文本：footnotetext:通讯作者: 李根.Corresponding author: Gen Li.

Changxiao Cai Department of Industrial and Operations Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, USA; Email: cxcai@umich.edu.    Gen Li Department of Statistics and Data Science, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong; Email: genli@cuhk.edu.hk.
摘要Abstract

扩散语言模型 (DLM) 已成为语言建模自回归 (AR) 模型的一种有前景的替代方案，允许灵活的生成顺序和并行生成多个标记。然而，这种灵活性带来了 AR 模型中不存在的挑战：Diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) models for language modeling, allowing flexible generation order and parallel generation of multiple tokens. However, this flexibility introduces a challenge absent in AR models: the解码策略decoding strategy——它决定了每次迭代生成的令牌的顺序和数量——严重影响采样效率。在实践中探索的解码策略中，基于置信度的方法（根据预测置信度自适应地选择要解密的标记和数量）已显示出强大的经验性能。尽管取得了这一成功，我们对基于置信度的解码的理论理解仍然有限。—which determines the order and number of tokens generated at each iteration—critically affects sampling efficiency. Among decoding strategies explored in practice, confidence-based methods, which adaptively select which and how many tokens to unmask based on prediction confidence, have shown strong empirical performance. Despite this success, our theoretical understanding of confidence-based decoding remains limited.

在这项工作中，我们开发了第一个用于 DLM 中基于置信度的解码的理论分析框架。我们专注于基于熵和的策略，该策略在每次迭代中继续揭露标记，直到累积熵超过阈值，并表明它实现了In this work, we develop the first theoretical analysis framework for confidence-based decoding in DLMs. We focus on an entropy sum-based strategy that continues unmasking tokens within each iteration until the cumulative entropy exceeds a threshold, and show that it achievesε\varepsilon- KL 散度中的准确采样具有预期的迭代次数-accurate sampling in KL divergence with an expected number of iterationsO~​(H​(X0)/ε)\widetilde{O}(H(X_{0})/\varepsilon), 其中, whereH​(X0)H(X_{0})表示目标数据分布的熵。值得注意的是，当数据分布相对于序列长度具有较低熵时，该策略会产生显着的采样加速，同时自动适应数据的内在复杂性，而不需要先验知识或超参数调整。总的来说，我们的结果为基于置信度的解码提供了理论基础，并且可以为 DLM 设计更有效的解码策略提供信息。denotes the entropy of the target data distribution. Notably, this strategy yields substantial sampling acceleration when the data distribution has low entropy relative to the sequence length, while automatically adapting to the intrinsic complexity of data without requiring prior knowledge or hyperparameter tuning. Overall, our results provide a theoretical foundation for confidence-based decoding and may inform the design of more efficient decoding strategies for DLMs.

关键词：Keywords:扩散语言模型，基于置信度的解码，迭代复杂度，信息论diffusion language model, confidence-based decoding, iteration complexity, information theory

1 简介Introduction

扩散语言模型 (DLM)Diffusion language models (DLMs)(Sahoo et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2024)最近成为语言建模自回归（AR）范式的一个引人注目的替代方案。 与 AR 模型不同，DLM 使用非因果生成机制，可以在每次迭代时并行生成多个令牌，并放松严格的从左到右的约束。 并行生成能力为采样加速提供了强大的潜力，而非因果结构也使 DLM 非常适合受益于双向推理或全局约束执行的任务have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to the autoregressive (AR) paradigm for language modeling. Unlike AR models, DLMs use a non-causal generation mechanism that can produce multiple tokens in parallel at each iteration and relax the rigid left-to-right constraint. The parallel generation capability offers strong potential for sampling acceleration, while the non-causal structure also makes DLMs well suited to tasks that benefit from bidirectional reasoning or the enforcement of global constraints(Nie et al., 2025; Prabhudesai et al., 2025)。 在规模上，DLM 已被证明可以实现与 AR 模型相媲美的性能. At scale, DLMs have been shown to achieve performance competitive with AR models(Ye et al., 2025; Song et al., 2025; You et al., 2025; Zhu et al., 2025; Bie et al., 2025; Labs et al., 2025).

最先进的 DLM 建立在State-of-the-art DLMs are built upon掩蔽扩散模型masked diffusion models（主数据管理）(MDMs)(Austin et al., 2021; Campbell et al., 2022; Lou et al., 2023)，一类离散扩散模型，通过额外的吸收状态来增强词汇量，称为, a class of discrete diffusion models that augment the vocabulary with an additional absorbing state, referred to as面具mask。 MDM 是通过两个互补的流程定义的。在前向（屏蔽）过程中，从目标数据分布中提取的序列中的标记逐渐被屏蔽替换，直到序列被完全屏蔽。 然后，反向（揭开）过程试图通过迭代恢复屏蔽标记来反转这种损坏，从而将完全屏蔽的序列转换为数据分布中的新鲜样本。. An MDM is defined through two complementary processes. In the forward (masking) process, tokens in a sequence drawn from the target data distribution are progressively replaced by the mask until the sequence becomes fully masked. The reverse (unmasking) process then seeks to invert this corruption by iteratively recovering masked tokens, thereby transforming a fully masked sequence into a fresh sample from the data distribution.

逆向过程的核心是Central to the reverse process is a掩模预测器mask predictor，它学习给定当前未屏蔽上下文的各种屏蔽级别的屏蔽标记的条件分布, which learns the conditional distributions of masked tokens given the currently unmasked context at various masking levels(Lou et al., 2023; Ou et al., 2024; Zheng et al., 2024)。 反向动态是通过从这些条件中重复采样令牌值来估算屏蔽位置来实现的，从而从完全屏蔽的序列转向类似数据的样本。 从这个意义上说，MDM 中的掩模预测器充当连续扩散模型中分数估计器的离散模拟. The reverse dynamics are implemented by repeatedly sampling token values from these conditionals to impute masked positions, thereby moving from a fully masked sequence toward a data-like sample. In this sense, the mask predictor in MDMs serves as a discrete analog of the score estimator in continuous diffusion models(Song et al., 2020)。 由于多个掩码标记的联合分布在高维设置中通常很棘手，因此通常训练实用的掩码预测器来学习每个掩码标记的条件边际，并使用每个标记条件边际的乘积作为近似值. As the joint distribution of multiple masked tokens is generally intractable in high-dimensional settings, practical mask predictors are typically trained to learn the conditional marginals of each masked token, and use the product of per-token conditional marginals as an approximation(Nie et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2025)。 特别是，基于神经网络的掩模预测器可以在一次前向传递中输出所有当前掩模位置的条件边缘分布。. In particular, a neural network-based mask predictor can output, in one forward pass, conditional marginal distributions for all currently masked positions.

虽然这种分解近似可以并行生成 DLM，但它也在采样阶段引入了不可避免的偏差——在一次迭代中同时揭开多个标记会忽略它们对当前显示的上下文的统计依赖性。 在一种极端情况下，在单次迭代中揭开所有标记会产生与目标分布与其边际乘积之间的差异相当的误差。在另一个极端，逐一生成代币恢复了标准 AR 方法，它消除了因式分解偏差，但牺牲了 DLM 的并行生成优势。While this factorized approximation enables parallel generation of DLMs, it also introduces an inevitable bias in the sampling stage—simultaneously unmasking multiple tokens in one iteration ignores their statistical dependence conditioned on the currently revealed context. At one extreme, unmasking all tokens in a single iteration incurs an error comparable to the discrepancy between the target distribution and the product of its marginals. At the other extreme, generating tokens one-by-one recovers the standard AR approach, which removes the factorization bias but sacrifices the parallel generation advantage of DLMs.

因此，DLM 的采样速度和生成质量关键取决于推理阶段使用的解码（或取消屏蔽）策略，该策略决定了每次迭代时要取消屏蔽的位置以及要显示的标记数量。Therefore, the sampling speed and generation quality of DLMs depend critically on the decoding (or unmasking) strategy used at the inference stage, which determines both which positions to unmask and how many tokens to reveal at each iteration.

并行解码策略。Parallel decoding strategies.

实践中使用的解码策略可以大致分为两类。Decoding strategies used in practice can be broadly categorized into two families.

  • •

    统一的解码策略。Uniform decoding strategies.此类解码策略规定了固定的总迭代次数This class of decoding strategies prescribes a fixed total iteration countTT和一个步长计划and a step-size schedules1,s2​…,sTs_{1},s_{2}\dots,s_{T}与withst≥1s_{t}\geq 1和and∑t=1Tst=L\sum_{t=1}^{T}s_{t}=L（例如， 余弦时间表(e.g., cosine schedules(Shi et al., 2024)或对数线性时间表or log-linear schedules(Sahoo et al., 2024; Lou et al., 2023)）。 在每次迭代时). At each iterationtt，一个样本大小的子集, one samples a subset of sizests_{t}从剩余的屏蔽位置均匀地随机，然后取消屏蔽采样子集中的标记。 请注意，这一系列方案统一处理所有屏蔽位置，因此属于更广泛的非自适应解码策略类别。uniformly at random from the remaining masked positions and then unmasks the tokens in the sampled subset. Note that this family of schemes treats all masked positions uniformly and thus belongs to the broader class of non-adaptive decoding strategies.

  • •

    基于置信度的解码策略。Confidence-based decoding strategies.该解码策略集合利用了这样一个事实：掩码预测器不仅提供分布，还为每个标记预测提供自然置信度信号。因此，很自然地首先揭开“最简单”的标记（那些以高置信度预测的标记），以便新发现的标记可以在以后的迭代中作为较难的标记的附加上下文This collection of decoding strategies leverages the fact that a mask predictor provides not only a distribution but also a natural confidence signal for each token prediction. It is thus natural to unmask the “easiest” tokens first—those predicted with high confidence—so that newly revealed tokens can serve as additional context for the harder ones in later iterations(Chang et al., 2022; Zheng et al., 2023; Gong et al., 2024)。在实践中，置信度通常通过预测分布的熵来量化. In practice, confidence is often quantified by the entropy of the predicted distribution(Ben-Hamu et al., 2025)，最有可能的令牌的质量, the mass of the most likely token(Nie et al., 2025; Yu et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2025)，或两个最有可能的标记之间的可能性差距, or the likelihood gap between the two most likely tokens(Kim et al., 2025)，从而产生一系列有效的启发法。与统一解码策略相比，这些方案以自适应方式确定解码顺序和批量大小。, leading to a range of effective heuristics. Compared to uniform decoding strategies, these schemes determine the decoding order and batch size in an adaptive manner.

与经验解码策略的快速发展相比，我们对其采样效率的理论理解仍然有限。 对于均匀随机调度，最近在建立采样性能的理论保证方面取得了实质性进展In contrast to the rapid development of empirical decoding strategies, our theoretical understanding of their sampling efficiency remains limited. For uniform random schedules, substantial recent progress has been made in establishing theoretical guarantees for sampling performance(Li and Cai, 2025; Chen et al., 2025b; Lavenant and Zanella, 2025; Dmitriev et al., 2026; Zhao and Cai, 2026)。 我们推迟详细讨论部分. We defer a detailed discussion to Section1.2。 相比之下，尽管基于置信度的解码具有很强的经验表现，但理论上的理解仍然远远不够。 根本困难在于其固有的自适应解码动态：每次迭代时揭露的标记集取决于. By comparison, despite their strong empirical performance, confidence-based decoding remains far less understood theoretically. The fundamental difficulty lies in their inherently adaptive decoding dynamics: the set of tokens unmasked at each iteration depends on the实现realization通过掩模预测器产生的相应置信水平，到目前为止生成的标记的数量。 这种适应性提出了几个基本但尚未解答的问题。例如，如果迭代总数未预先确定，则需要多少次迭代才能揭开所有标记？由此产生的抽样误差是多少？这些方案能否证明能够适应数据分布的（未知）内在复杂性或依赖结构？of the tokens generated so far, through the corresponding confidence levels produced by the mask predictor. This adaptivity raises several fundamental but unanswered questions. For instance, if the total number of iterations is not predetermined, how many iterations are needed to unmask all tokens? What is the resulting sampling error? Can these schemes provably adapt to the (unknown) intrinsic complexity or dependence structure of the data distribution?

这种理论与实践的差距激发了我们研究的核心问题：Such a theory-practice gap motivates the central question of our study:

DLM 中基于置信度的解码策略是否被证明有效？Are confidence-based decoding strategies in DLMs provably efficient?

1.1 我们的贡献Our contributions

在这项工作中，我们迈出了回答这个问题的第一步，为 DLM 中基于置信度的解码开发采样收敛保证，目的是揭开其实际有效性的神秘面纱。In this work, we take an initial step toward answering this question by developing sampling convergence guarantees for confidence-based decoding in DLMs, with the goal of demystifying their practical effectiveness.

我们专注于规范的置信度度量（熵），并研究基于熵的解码，该解码根据每个屏蔽位置的预测分布的熵来选择揭露位置和批量大小。 具体来说，我们研究一个有代表性的We focus on a canonical confidence measure—entropy—and investigate entropy-based decoding that selects unmasking positions and batch sizes based on the entropy of the predicted distribution at each masked position. Concretely, we study a representative基于熵和的策略entropy sum-based strategy在每次迭代中，贪婪地从剩余的屏蔽位置中揭开令牌，直到新揭开的令牌的运行熵和超过规定的阈值，从而在每次迭代中揭示尽可能多的令牌，同时保持累积预测不确定性受到控制。that, at each iteration, greedily unmasks tokens from the remaining masked positions until the running entropy sum of the newly unmasked tokens exceeds a prescribed threshold, thereby revealing as many tokens as possible per iteration while keeping the cumulative prediction uncertainty controlled.

我们证明We demonstrate thatε\varepsilon- Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度的准确度可以通过预期的迭代次数来实现，其缩放比例为-accuracy in Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence can be attained with an expected number of iterations that scales as

O~​(H​(X0)ε).\displaystyle\widetilde{O}\bigg(\frac{H(X_{0})}{\varepsilon}\bigg).

该结果意味着序列长度的次线性迭代复杂度This result implies a sublinear iteration complexity in the sequence lengthLL当数据分布具有低熵时when the data distribution has low entropyH​(X0)≪LH(X_{0})\ll L，从而与相比实现了可证明的采样加速, thereby achieving provable sampling speedup compared to theΘ​(L)\Theta(L)AR 解码或朴素统一并行解码的迭代复杂度。 值得注意的是，该方案不需要任何数据分布的先验知识，例如其熵，因此自动适应固有的低复杂度数据结构以实现采样加速。iteration complexity of the AR decoding or naive uniform parallel decoding. Notably, this scheme does not require any prior knowledge of the data distribution such as its entropy, and thus automatically adapts to the intrinsic low-complexity data structure to achieve sampling acceleration.

为了建立这些结果，我们引入了一种新的分析框架，用于 DLM 中的自适应解码动态，这可能是独立感兴趣的。 总的来说，我们的结果为基于置信度的揭露策略的有效性提供了第一个理论依据，并为基于熵的解码何时以及为何可以在不牺牲生成保真度的情况下实现加速采样提供了原则性解释。 我们的理论见解可以为实践中更有效的推理方案的设计提供信息。To establish these results, we introduce a novel analysis framework for adaptive decoding dynamics in DLMs that may be of independent interest. Overall, our results provide the first theoretical justification for the effectiveness of confidence-based unmasking strategies, and offer a principled explanation of when and why entropy-based decoding can achieve accelerated sampling without sacrificing generation fidelity. Our theoretical insights may inform the design of more efficient inference schemes in practice.

1.2 其他相关工作Other related work

统一解码策略的收敛理论。Convergence theory for uniform decoding strategies.

现有的 DLM 采样收敛分析主要集中在统一解码策略上，并追求两个主要观点。 第一条工作直接研究因式分解近似下迭代揭露过程中累积的采样误差。 对于平衡步长计划（即Existing sampling convergence analysis for DLMs largely focuses on uniform decoding strategies and two main viewpoints have been pursued. The first line of work directly studies the sampling error accumulated in the iterative unmasking procedure under the factorized approximation. They also proved matching lower bounds (up to constant factors), showing that theO​(1/T)O(1/T)在最坏的情况下，对于平衡步长调度来说，衰减是无法改善的。 随后，decay is unimprovable for balanced step-size schedules in the worst case. Subsequently,Chen et al. (2025b)使用数据分布的总相关性和对偶总相关性细化收敛速度，并制定最佳步长计划。这些调度可以优于平衡步长调度，尽管需要对这些相关性度量进行先验估计或超参数调整。 最近，refined the convergence rate using the total correlation and dual total correlation of the data distribution, and developed optimal step-size schedules. These schedules can outperform balanced step-size schedules, albeit requiring either a priori estimates of these correlation measures or hyperparameter tuning. Recently,Zhao and Cai (2026)表明随机步长计划可以自动适应底层数据的内在依赖结构，从而提高结构化数据分布的迭代复杂性。 并行观点从CTMC离散化角度分析离散扩散模型。 然而，这个方向上的大多数结果都会产生迭代复杂度，该复杂度至少在序列长度上呈线性缩放showed that randomized step-size schedules can automatically adapt to intrinsic dependence structure underlying data, leading to improved iteration complexity for structured data distributions. A parallel viewpoint analyzes discrete diffusion models from the perspective of CTMC discretization. However, most results in this direction yield iteration complexity that scales at least linearly in the sequence length(Chen and Ying, 2024; Liang et al., 2025b; Feng et al., 2025; Ren et al., 2024, 2025; Liang et al., 2026)。因此，他们无法捕获 DLM 解码中的并行生成机制。一个值得注意的例外是. Consequently, they fail to capture the parallel-generation regime in DLM decoding. A notable exception isDmitriev et al. (2026)，它为 MDM 开发了敏锐且自适应的保证，其收敛速度由数据的低复杂性度量控制。, which developed sharp and adaptive guarantees for MDMs, with convergence rate governed by low-complexity measures of data.

基于经验的置信策略。Empirical confidence-based strategies.

早期基于置信度的方法通常使用固定大小策略，该策略规定了揭露大小Early confidence-based approaches typically use a fixed-size strategy, which prescribes an unmasking sizeKK并揭开顶部的面具-and unmasks the top-KK每次迭代中最有信心的标记most confident tokens at each iteration(Chang et al., 2022)。 这个想法已经通过几个排名标准具体化，包括 顶-. This idea has been instantiated with several ranking criteria, including top-KK概率probability(Nie et al., 2025), 顶-, top-KK保证金margin(Kim et al., 2025)，以及顶部-, and top-KK熵entropy(Ben-Hamu et al., 2025)。 最近的工作考虑了自适应策略，其中新揭开的令牌的数量是动态确定的。 示例包括基于阈值的规则，该规则揭示置信度超过规定水平的令牌. More recent work considers adaptive strategies, where the number of newly unmasked tokens is determined on the fly. Examples include threshold-based rules that reveal tokens whose confidence exceeds a prescribed level(Yu et al., 2025)，以及基于预算的战略，在累积的不确定性仍然在预算范围内的情况下继续揭露, and budget-based strategies that continue unmasking while the accumulated uncertainty remains within a budget(Ben-Hamu et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2025)。本文分析的方法属于此类。 除了这些一步置信规则之外，还有一些工作将置信信息与更结构化的解码过程结合起来。例如，. The methods analyzed in this paper fall into this category. Beyond those one-step confidence rules, several works combine confidence information with more structured decoding procedures. For instance,Wei et al. (2025)提出了一种两阶段方法，根据置信区域在探索性解码策略和加速解码策略之间交替。 此外，另一项工作旨在通过明确地提前规划未来的迭代来改进解码，而不是做出纯粹短视的决策，包括基于前瞻的探索方法proposes a two-stage method that alternates between exploratory and accelerated decoding strategies depending on the confidence region. In addition, another line of work seeks to improve decoding by explicitly planning ahead for future iterations rather than making purely myopic decisions, including lookahead-based exploration methods(Fu et al., 2025; Lee et al., 2025; Peng et al., 2025)和试验验证程序and trial-and-verification procedures(Wu and Zhang, 2025; Li et al., 2026)。 最后，为了减轻标准 MDM 在令牌被揭露后对其进行修复的限制，最近的工作还研究了基于置信度的重新屏蔽机制，该机制允许在以后的迭代中修改低置信度令牌. Finally, to mitigate the limitation of standard MDMs that fix tokens once they are unmasked, recent work has also studied confidence-based remasking mechanisms that allow low-confidence tokens to be revised in later iterations(Wang et al., 2025; Shi et al., 2024).

连续扩散模型的理论。Theory for continuous diffusion models.

大量的工作已经为连续扩散模型开发了采样收敛保证A rich body of work has developed sampling convergence guarantees for continuous diffusion models inℝd\mathbb{R}^{d} (Lee et al., 2022; Chen et al., 2022; Lee et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2023a; Benton et al., 2023; Li and Yan, 2024b; Li et al., 2024b), 与 最先进的迭代复杂度, with state-of-the-art iteration complexity ofO~​(d/ε)\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/\varepsilon})KL 散度和in KL divergence andO~​(d/ε)\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d}/\varepsilon)总变异距离in total variation distance(Jiao et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025)。 进一步开发了多种可证明加速的采样器. A variety of provably accelerated samplers have been further developed(Li and Cai, 2024; Li and Jiao, 2024; Gatmiry et al., 2026; Huang et al., 2024a; Li et al., 2024a, 2025b)。 与我们工作相关的一个主题是对（未知）低复杂性结构的适应性。近期几部作品. A theme relevant to our work is the adaptivity to (unknown) low-complexity structure. Several recent works(Li and Yan, 2024a; Liang et al., 2025a; Huang et al., 2024b; Potaptchik et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025a)表明当数据分布集中在show that when the data distribution concentrates near akk维结构与-dimensional structure withk≪dk\ll d，对环境尺寸的依赖性, the dependence on the ambient dimensiondd可以用内在维度代替can be replaced by the intrinsic dimensionkk，产生显着的采样加速度。 除了采样收敛之外，还开发了端到端统计保证来证明基于扩散的分布学习和样本生成的最优性, yielding substantial sampling acceleration. Beyond sampling convergence, end-to-end statistical guarantees have been developed to demonstrate the optimality of diffusion-based distribution learning and sample generation(Oko et al., 2023; Wibisono et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024; Cai and Li, 2025; Gatmiry et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024)。 还建立了针对结构化数据定制的进一步结果，包括低维线性子空间或流形上支持的分布. Further results tailored to structured data have also been established, including distributions supported on low-dimensional linear subspaces or manifolds(Chen et al., 2023b; Tang and Yang, 2024; Azangulov et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2024; Yakovlev and Puchkin, 2025)，具有低复杂度依赖性的分布, distributions with low-complexity dependence(Fan et al., 2025)和因子模型, and factor models(Chen et al., 2025a).

掩模预测器训练。Mask predictor training.

DLM 经过训练，通过学习给定未屏蔽标记的屏蔽标记的条件分布，来反转上述前向屏蔽过程。 掩模预测器训练的一个显着特征是，后验分布与时间无关——它仅取决于未掩模的上下文，而不取决于掩模步骤DLMs are trained to reverse the above forward masking process by learning the conditional distribution of masked tokens given the unmasked ones. A notable feature of mask predictor training is that this posterior distribution is time-independent—it depends only on the unmasked context and not on the masking steptt (Ou et al., 2024; Zheng et al., 2024)。 更准确地说，对于每个代币索引. 掩码预测器是通过最大化以未掩码标记为条件的掩码标记的对数似然来训练的：The mask predictor is trained by maximizing the log-likelihood of masked tokens conditioned on unmasked ones:

maxpθ=∏i=1Lpθi⁡𝔼X0,𝒮​[1|𝒮c|​∑i∈𝒮clog⁡pθi​(X0i∣X0𝒮)].\displaystyle\max_{p_{\theta}=\prod_{i=1}^{L}p_{\theta}^{i}}\mathbb{E}_{X_{0},\mathcal{S}}\Bigg[\frac{1}{|\mathcal{S}^{\mathrm{c}}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{S}^{\mathrm{c}}}\log p^{i}_{\theta}\big(X_{0}^{i}\mid X_{0}^{\mathcal{S}}\big)\Bigg]. (5)

3 主要结果Main results

在本节中，我们提出了两种基于熵的 DLM 解码策略并建立了它们的理论保证。我们从基于熵和的策略开始，这是本文的主要算法结果，然后研究基于最大熵的变体来说明熵准则的选择如何影响采样效率。In this section, we present two entropy-based decoding strategies for DLMs and establish their theoretical guarantees. We begin with the entropy sum-based strategy, which is the main algorithmic result of the paper, and then study a maximum entropy-based variant to illustrate how the choice of entropy criterion affects sampling efficiency.

3.1 基于熵和的解码策略Entropy sum-based decoding strategy

我们首先介绍基于熵和的解码策略。其关键特征是每次解码迭代都是由当前批次未屏蔽令牌累积的总不确定性决定的，该总不确定性通过熵来测量。这导致了一种自适应规则，该规则会在低不确定性区域中自动扩大去屏蔽集，并在屏蔽预测器不确定时缩小它。We first introduce the entropy sum-based decoding strategy. Its key feature is that each decoding iteration is determined by the total uncertainty, measured by entropy, accumulated over the current batch of unmasked tokens. This leads to an adaptive rule that enlarges the unmasking set automatically in low-uncertainty regions and shrinks it when the mask predictor is uncertain.

解码过程。Decoding procedure.

在较高级别上，基于熵和的策略以随机顺序扫描剩余的屏蔽位置，并继续取消屏蔽标记，直到当前批次的累积熵超过阈值。At a high level, the entropy sum-based strategy scans the remaining masked positions in a random order and continues unmasking tokens until the cumulative entropy of the current batch exceeds a threshold.

具体来说，我们首先画一个排列Concretely, we first draw a permutationΠ\Pi of [L][L]均匀随机，其中uniformly at random, whereΠk\Pi_{k}表示的索引represents the index of thekk-th 标记将被揭开。 然后我们重复以下解码过程，直到生成所有令牌。 在每次迭代时-th token to be unmasked. We then repeat the following decoding procedure until all tokens have been generated. At each iterationt≥1t\geq 1，我们初始化当前的去屏蔽集, we initialize the current unmasking set𝒟t=∅\mathcal{D}_{t}=\varnothing和运行熵和and the running entropy sumS=0S=0。 回想一下，对于任何集合. Recall that for any set𝒲\mathcal{W}，我们使用大写字母, we use the upper-case letterW=|𝒲|W=|\mathcal{W}|来表示它的大小。 给定部分未屏蔽的序列to denote its size. 与基于经验熵和的策略的连接。Connection to empirical entropy sum-based strategies.

算法Algorithm1与最近提出的基于熵的解码策略密切相关is closely related to the entropy-based decoding strategy recently proposed inBen-Hamu et al. (2025)。他们的方法通过条件熵对剩余的标记进行排序，然后选择熵和与最大熵之间的差距保持在规定阈值以下的最大子集。 数值结果为. Their method sorts the remaining tokens by conditional entropy and then selects the largest subset for which the gap between the entropy sum and the maximum entropy remains below a prescribed threshold. Numerical results inBen-Hamu et al. (2025)证明这种基于熵和的解码策略在生成过程中实现了相当大的加速，其质量可以匹配或超过统一的解密方案。 主要区别在于算法demonstrate that such an entropy sum-based decoding strategy achieves considerable speedups in generation, with quality that matches or surpasses that of uniform unmasking schemes. The main difference is that Algorithm1以随机顺序而不是确定性熵排序顺序扫描令牌位置。 我们引入这种随机性主要是为了促进理论分析，研究是否可以为确定性变体建立类似的理论保证将是很有趣的。scans token positions in a random order instead of a deterministic entropy-sorted order. We introduce this randomness primarily to facilitate the theoretical analysis, and it would be of interest to investigate whether similar theoretical guarantees can be established for the deterministic variants.

This highlights the distribution-agnostic adaptivity of the entropy-based decoding—it automatically exploits low-complexity structure in the target distribution to accelerate generation.

3.3 熵准则的影响Effect of entropy criterion

一个自然的问题是熵准则的选择如何影响解码效率。 为了研究这个问题，我们提出了第二种基于熵的解码策略——A natural question is how the choice of entropy criterion affects decoding efficiency. To investigate this, we present a second entropy-based decoding strategy—the基于最大熵的策略maximum entropy-based strategy——这与单一设计选择中基于熵和的策略不同。 它不是控制整个批次的累积熵，而是在任何单个标记的条件熵超过规定阈值时立即终止迭代，并受到批次大小的明确上限的影响。—which differs from the entropy sum-based strategy in a single design choice. Instead of controlling the cumulative entropy of the entire batch, it terminates an iteration as soon as any single token’s conditional entropy exceeds a prescribed threshold, subject to an explicit cap on the batch size.

正如我们很快就会看到的，这种替代策略仍然在序列长度上实现了次线性的迭代复杂度。然而，它的采样保证在两个方面较弱：迭代复杂度范围较宽松，参数选择需要了解目标分布的熵。 这种对比凸显了如何将熵纳入解码策略设计的重要性。As we will see shortly, this alternative strategy still achieves an iteration complexity sublinear in the sequence length. However, its sampling guarantee is weaker in two respects: the iteration complexity bound is looser, and the parameter choice requires knowledge of the entropy of the target distribution. This contrast highlights the importance of how entropy is incorporated into the design of decoding strategies.

然而，与基于熵和的策略相比，这种基于最大熵的策略有两个重要的缺点：Nevertheless, compared with the entropy sum-based strategy, this maximum entropy-based strategy has two important shortcomings:

  • •

    在并行采样机制中，迭代复杂度小于序列长度In the parallel sampling regime, where the iteration complexity is smaller than the sequence lengthLL, 中的界限 (, the bound in (13) 比 () is worse than that in (10) 的一个因数) by a factor ofε​L/H​(X0)≫1\sqrt{\varepsilon L/H(X_{0})}\gg 1.

  • •

    参数选择The parameter choicesη\eta和andSmaxS_{\max}实现亚线性迭代复杂度所需的需要明确的熵知识needed to achieve a sublinear iteration complexity require explicit knowledge of the entropyH​(X0)H(X_{0})目标数据分布。这与基于熵和的策略形成鲜明对比，后者是完全分布自适应的。of the target data distribution. This stands in stark contrast to the entropy sum-based strategy, which is fully distribution-adaptive.

由于这两种基于熵的解码策略的理论保证是在相同的分析框架下建立的， 比较它们表明熵准则的选择在高效的基于熵的解码中起着至关重要的作用。 因此，未来的一个重要方向是更深入地了解不同的熵标准如何影响 DLM 的采样性能，例如，通过推导各种解码策略的迭代复杂度的算法相关下限。Since the theoretical guarantees for these two entropy-based decoding strategies are established under the same analysis framework, comparing them suggests that the choice of entropy criterion plays a critical role in efficient entropy-based decoding. An important future direction is thus to develop a deeper understanding of how different entropy criteria affect the sampling performance of DLMs, for example, by deriving algorithm-dependent lower bounds on the iteration complexity of various decoding strategies.

5 讨论Discussion

在这项工作中，我们在了解 DLM 中基于置信度的解码策略的采样效率方面取得了进展。我们的结果表明，基于熵的揭露策略可以证明加速采样，当数据分布具有低熵时，实现序列长度次线性的迭代复杂度。值得注意的是，他们揭示了基于熵的策略可以适应数据分布的未知内在复杂性，而不需要任何先验知识或超参数调整。In this work, we have made progress toward understanding the sampling efficiency of confidence-based decoding strategies in DLMs. Our results show that entropy-based unmasking strategies can provably accelerate sampling, achieving an iteration complexity that is sublinear in the sequence length when the data distribution has low entropy. Notably, they reveal that entropy-based strategies can adapt to the unknown intrinsic complexity of the data distribution without requiring any prior knowledge or hyperparameter tuning.

展望未来，了解基于确定性顺序（例如排序顺序）而不是本工作中考虑的随机顺序的基于熵的解码方案的性能将会很有趣。此外，将我们的分析扩展到熵之外的更一般的置信度度量也是有价值的，例如最可能的标记的质量和两个最可能的标记之间的质量差距。 其次，我们当前的分析重点是使用最佳掩模预测器的场景。了解掩模预测器中的训练误差对基于置信度的解码下采样性能的影响非常重要，这可能会为 DLM 设计更有效的训练目标提供见解。 第三，另一个重要方向是建立基于置信度的解码方案的迭代复杂度的下限，这将揭示使用此类策略时采样加速的基本限制。Moving forward, it would be of interest to understand the performance of the entropy-based decoding schemes based on a deterministic order (e.g., a sorted order) instead of the random order considered in this work. Also, it would be valuable to extend our analysis to more general confidence measures beyond entropy, such as the mass of the most likely token and the mass gap between the two most likely tokens. Second, our current analysis focuses on the scenario where the optimal mask predictor is used. It would be important to understand the impact of training error in the mask predictor on the sampling performance under confidence-based decoding, which may yield insights into the design of more effective training objectives for DLMs. Third, another important direction is to establish lower bounds on the iteration complexity of confidence-based decoding schemes, which would shed light on the fundamental limits of sampling acceleration when using this class of strategies.
